_help: One entry per document. To add a year: put the PDF in the project folder, add its extraction as raw/<year>.json (and raw/mid<year>.json for a Mid-Year Review), add an entry below, then run: python site/tools/build_data.py. pdf is relative to the project folder. page_offset is PDF page minus printed page. title and presenter override what the extraction says. prior_year_ytd names the year-to-date budget-vs-outturn fields this budget gives for the previous year.
